newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR WEAKENS UNDER IMPORT PRESSURE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR WEAKENS UNDER IMPORT PRESSURE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer against most hard currencies on the back of slight import pressure on Monday.
"Nothing much is happening at the moment but our dollar has fallen a bit from where it opened meaning there is demand for (U.S.) dollars," said one dealer.
"We haven't seen the Reserve Bank yet and we're just waiting for the day's progression," he added.
At around 0730 GMT the local unit was trading at 11.3150/3250 against the U.S. dollar, down from Friday's 11.2900/3000 and was also weaker at 18.3500/3700 from 18.3210/3490 versus sterling.
It was at 2.5400/5600 from 2.5350/5390 against the South African rand but strengthened against the mark to 6.5200/5400 from 6.5770/5850, tracking a firmer U.S. dollar on the German unit overseas.
